## Generated behavior

What changes in generated repositories?

## Layer and scope

Which layer changes: core, add-on, tooling, standard, or manifest contract? What is explicitly out of scope?

## Delete / simplify

What unnecessary behavior, duplication, file, or abstraction was removed or avoided? If none, why is the added complexity necessary?

## Acceptance criteria

What observable conditions define success?

## Evidence

What is the simplest reliable evidence that proves the acceptance criteria? For generated behavior, include the failing-before and passing-after generation assertion because that check is cheap and protects every future output.

## Compatibility

Do existing manifests still validate and generate? Note any deliberate output or manifest contract change.

## Security and risk

Could this produce unsafe, mixed, over-privileged, executable, or unexpectedly destructive generated output? How is that constrained?
